title: OSINT interference map from free data: ADS-B NACp hexes and Sentinel-1 C-band RFI over Kaliningrad / the SE Baltic
summary: Two no-login OSINT layers for the same area and morning (2026-10-01, SE Baltic around Kaliningrad). ADS-B: the ADS-B Exchange free readsb-hist sample (1st of each month) is cut to a bbox and binned into H3 hexes with the GPSJam percentage formula on aircraft-reported NACp. Sentinel-1: an 18-scene GRD stack of one relative orbit from Microsoft Planetary Computer, scored two ways - ESA's own per-swath RFI annotation (rfiDetected, KL divergence, in-band/out-band power) and a port of zephr-xyz/sentinel1-rfi-detection's temporal z-score on VH backscatter. Outputs a GeoJSON loadable by templates/demo-dashboard, navdash/1 point tracks of the aircraft reports, and a PNG map.
verified: ran on 2026-11-06 with Python 3.13.15 (macOS arm64) against live public data, no credentials: adsb_hexmap.py pulled 121 ADS-B Exchange snapshots (2026-10-01 03:51-05:51 UTC, 60 s step) => 110 of 129 classified aircraft NACp<8, 64 red hexes, 0 green; control run over NL/DE (13 snapshots, 600 s step) => 19 of 879 bad, 108 green hexes. s1_rfi.py processed 18 S1C/S1D GRD scenes of relative orbit 51 (2026-07-15..2026-10-31, VH at 1/8 resolution, Copernicus DEM slope mask): target scene 2026-10-01 04:51 UTC had 0.128% of pixels at z>3 and 0 candidate hexes; ESA rfiDetected on 9 of 18 dates, one IW3 strip NW of the Sambia peninsula on 6 dates. make_map.py wrote zones.geojson + map.png; the dashboard loaded the manifest in headless Chrome (screenshot out/dashboard.png). 8 offline unit tests pass. Not verified: any link between the C-band RFI and GNSS jammers, land/sea separation, other regions or dates beyond 2026-08-14 (rerun: 38 candidate hexes, 25 of them centred over water per Natural Earth 50m, incl. 8 of the 10 strongest).
